description: A source tells how an activity started: a client, an appointment, a payment, an invoice, a document, a review or a cart. An activity references its source. One source can be referenced by more than one activity. A source does not change after it is created.

uid.description: The unique identifier of the source.

source_id.description: **Deprecated.** The legacy numeric identifier. Use `uid`. The tap does not return it.

business_uid.description: The business of the source. Returned only by the cross-tenant reads (the list without `business_uid`, and the tap). Null for a source of no business.

name.description:
How the activity started. A free string: the platform writes the values below, and apps and integrations write their own names (for example `Square` or `Thryv Leads`).

**Started by the business:**
- `initiated_by_staff` (older spelling: `staff_initiated`): a staff member created the activity.
- `automation`: an automation created it. With `campaign` = `scheduled_payments`, a scheduled payment.
- `automatic_messages`: an automatic message of the business led to it.
- `added_internally`: added inside the platform, for example by an import.

**Started by the client:**
- `website`, `Website`: a widget, form or button on the business website.
- `client_portal`: the client portal.
- `campaign`: a campaign. `campaign` holds the campaign uid.
- `email_campaign`, `marketing`, `invitation`, `forward`: an email campaign, a marketing channel, an invitation, a forwarded message.
- `text_to_business_phone`: a text message to the business phone.
- `promotions_optin_by_keyword` (also `promotions_opt-in_by_keyword`, `Promotions opt-in by Keyword`): an SMS keyword opt-in.
- `rwg_redirect`: Reserve with Google.
- `Messenger`, `Instagram`: a message to the AI Receptionist on that channel.
- `call`: a call to the AI voice receptionist. `campaign` holds the business phone number.

**Unknown:** `unknown`, or null.

channel.description: The channel inside the source, for example `scheduler_widget`, `contact_form`, `email`, `sms` or `AI Receptionist`.

campaign.description: The campaign or context, depending on `name`: a campaign uid, a message key, a phone number, or `scheduled_payments`.

website_url.description: The page where the activity started, or the social page name.

utm_source.description: Stored only for businesses with the sales account feature, as the other UTM fields and `gclid`.
